poweredIntro: A small ItsBagelBot badge slides onto your stream now and then, then slides away.
replaceHint: Replacing the link turns the old one off.
obsHint: In OBS, add it as a Browser source at 1920 by 1080.
readOnly: Only the channel owner can change overlays.
unavailable: Overlay settings are unavailable. Reload the page to try again.
saveFailed: Could not save overlay settings. Try again.
saveInvalid: These settings were refused. Reload the page and try again.
conflict: Overlay settings changed elsewhere. The latest settings were loaded. Try again.
replaceFailed: Could not replace the link. Try again.
copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Try again.
invalidAlign: Choose a position on the edge.
